source: Solver profiles sent with every analysis job (the claim's job.profile). Placeholders until guides/GD2 sets the residual targets, iteration caps and validation cases. The wind profile is render-jobs 1.2.0 section 6.5.4 (PF11c): realizable k-epsilon by default or k-omega SST, the Richards and Hoxey inlet with z0 by terrain (EN 1991-1-4 Table 4.1, terrain categories 0 to IV; confirm at writing time), rough-wall functions on the ground, converged at every residual below 1e-4 or at 2000 iterations, the background mesh by the job's quality.

lawson.source: The LDDC variant of the Lawson criteria (render-jobs 1.2.0 section 6.5.2) applied to the instantaneous speed of one direction, each class up to its speed; the annual combination with the weather file is the app's (AN3). GD2 placeholders until its validation cases pass.

airflow.method: the orifice network of render-jobs 1.2.0 section 6.5.4: Q = Cd A sqrt(2 |dp| / rho), Newton on each room's mass balance, the outdoor pressure Cp x 0.5 rho U_ref^2 with Cp from the wind job
